topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Hallmarks of Cancer Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This topic introduces the lecture by outlining its learning outcomes and framing tumorigenesis through Hanahan and Weinberg's Hallmarks of Cancer.

topics.label: Deregulated Growth and Proliferative Signaling Pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations deregulate signaling cascades such as Wnt, RTK/Ras/MAPK, and TGF-beta to sustain proliferation and evade growth inhibition.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how differentiation blocks halt normal lineage maturation in hematopoietic malignancies and colorectal carcinoma.

topics.label: Evasion of Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This topic explains how cancer cells resist programmed cell death through alterations in p53 and the balance of pro- and anti-apoptotic proteins.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Senescence Signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe cellular senescence and telomere dynamics, detailing how cancer cells bypass stress checkpoints and telomerase silencing to achieve immortalization.

topics.label: Cancer Metabolism and Metabolic Rewiring
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the metabolic reprogramming of cancer cells, focusing on aerobic glycolysis, the Warburg effect, and oncometabolite-driven epigenetic changes.

topics.label: Induction of Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how tumors induce new blood vessel growth for nutrient perfusion through shifts in the balance of angiogenic regulators.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Dynamics of Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: This topic examines the multi-step metastatic cascade, covering circulatory dissemination, sentinel lymph node diagnostics, circulating tumor cells, and the seed-and-soil hypothesis.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Summary
topics.groupedBecause: This topic concludes the lecture with closing remarks on hallmark integration, supplementary literature, and upcoming practicals.
